description.value: Melville Café is listed in OSM as a café at 1170 Melville Street in Vancouver, BC. The website associated with this OSM record, however, describes a distinct establishment operating inside the University of Waterloo School of Architecture in Cambridge, Ontario, overlooking the Grand River. Whether a real café operates at the Vancouver address cannot be determined from the available evidence.

Because the website content cannot be reliably attributed to the Vancouver location, all amenity evidence from the website is treated as inapplicable.
